card.name: Words before moving something indoors
card.fires_on: Verbs and small words just before a destination of moving or sheltering, such as back, be moved, go, seeking, indoors. The setting is moving a person or thing to a house, shelter or safe place.

modes.label: Carrying or moving to shelter
modes.description: Movement words where the next words name a house, shelter or safer place.
modes.example: Who carried Jem<< back>> to the house after he was hurt?

modes.label: Must be moved or stored
modes.description: Auxiliary or passive verbs in instructions to move or store items somewhere protected.
modes.example: Otherwise they must<< be>> moved somewhere cold and dry during the autumn

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning home, room or indoors, and away from outside.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to say something is taken home, inside or to shelter.
